tools.name: get_playbook
tools.description: Get the What-to-Fix playbook for a run (Premium/Portfolio). Requires a Save token proving ownership — run_id alone is not enough.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Fetch a stored HAIL result by run_id or share_slug.

tools.name: list_questions
tools.description: List HAIL assessment questions for simple, professional, or advanced profile. Advanced (real-number telemetry) is always available — no Premium required. Each question includes tier (core|extended) and core_position. Payload also returns core_count, core_keys, and extended_order.

tools.name: run_assessment
tools.description: Score a team assessment. Email is optional — anonymous runs are allowed. profile may be simple, professional, or advanced (advanced is always available, no Premium; answers are numeric measurements, not option indices). Core 8 answers are enough to place a hero; response includes core_complete and sharpen hints. Agents are bounded by the per-IP rate limit, not a free-run gate.
